functions.name: handle_new_user
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, email, full_name)
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.email, ''),
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', '')
  )
  on conflict (id) do update
  set email = excluded.email,
      full_name = coalesce(excluded.full_name, public.profiles.full_name);
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ads_os_claim_automation_rules(p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS SETOF ads_os_automation_rules
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 UPDATE public.ads_os_automation_rules r
 SET lease_until=now()+interval '10 minutes',next_run_at=now()+interval '1 hour'
 WHERE r.id IN (SELECT id FROM public.ads_os_automation_rules WHERE enabled
 AND next_run_at<=now() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<now())
 ORDER BY next_run_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT greatest(1,least(p_limit,10)))
 RETURNING r.*;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_course_editor.validate_course_note_lesson()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.lesson_id is not null and not exists (
    select 1
    from public.course_lessons l
    join public.course_modules m on m.id = l.module_id
    join public.course_chapters ch on ch.id = m.chapter_id
    where l.id = new.lesson_id
      and ch.course_id = new.course_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'course note lesson does not belong to course'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

private_functions.name: course_entity_snapshot
private_functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_course_editor.course_entity_snapshot(p_kind text, p_entity_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  snapshot jsonb;
begin
  case p_kind
    when 'course' then
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'kind', 'course', 'id', c.id, 'courseId', c.id,
        'title', c.title, 'description', c.description, 'version', c.version
      ) into snapshot from public.courses c where c.id = p_entity_id;
    when 'chapter' then
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'kind', 'chapter', 'id', ch.id, 'courseId', ch.course_id,
        'title', ch.title, 'description', ch.description, 'version', ch.version
      ) into snapshot from public.course_chapters ch where ch.id = p_entity_id;
    when 'module' then
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'kind', 'module', 'id', m.id, 'courseId', ch.course_id,
        'title', m.title, 'objective', m.objective, 'duration', m.duration,
        'status', m.status, 'version', m.version
      ) into snapshot
      from public.course_modules m
      join public.course_chapters ch on ch.id = m.chapter_id
      where m.id = p_entity_id;
    when 'lesson' then
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'kind', 'lesson', 'id', l.id, 'courseId', ch.course_id,
        'title', l.title, 'summary', l.summary, 'status', l.status, 'version', l.version
      ) into snapshot
      from public.course_lessons l
      join public.course_modules m on m.id = l.module_id
      join public.course_chapters ch on ch.id = m.chapter_id
      where l.id = p_entity_id;
    when 'assignment' then
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'kind', 'assignment', 'id', a.id, 'courseId', ch.course_id,
        'title', a.title, 'instructions', a.instructions_json, 'inputs', a.inputs_json,
        'deliverables', a.deliverables_json, 'rubric', a.rubric_json,
        'reviewQuestions', a.review_questions_json, 'instructorNote', a.instructor_note,
        'status', a.status, 'version', a.version
      ) into snapshot
      from public.course_assignments a
      join public.course_modules m on m.id = a.module_id
      join public.course_chapters ch on ch.id = m.chapter_id
      where a.id = p_entity_id;
    when 'appendix' then
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'kind', 'appendix', 'id', a.id, 'courseId', a.course_id,
        'title', a.title, 'content', a.content_json, 'status', a.status, 'version', a.version
      ) into snapshot from public.course_appendices a where a.id = p_entity_id;
    else
      raise exception 'unsupported editable course entity kind' using errcode = '22023';
  end case;
  if snapshot is null then raise exception 'course entity not found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  return snapshot;
end
$function$

private_functions.name: restore_course_entity
private_functions.args: p_kind text, p_entity_id uuid, p_expected_version integer, p_snapshot jsonb
private_functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_course_editor.restore_course_entity(p_kind text, p_entity_id uuid, p_expected_version integer, p_snapshot jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_snapshot ->> 'kind' is distinct from p_kind or p_snapshot ->> 'id' is distinct from p_entity_id::text then
    raise exception 'course entity snapshot mismatch' using errcode = '40001';
  end if;
  case p_kind
    when 'course' then
      update public.courses set
        title = p_snapshot ->> 'title', description = p_snapshot ->> 'description', version = version + 1
      where id = p_entity_id and version = p_expected_version;
    when 'chapter' then
      update public.course_chapters set
        title = p_snapshot ->> 'title', description = p_snapshot ->> 'description', version = version + 1
      where id = p_entity_id and version = p_expected_version;
    when 'module' then
      update public.course_modules set
        title = p_snapshot ->> 'title', objective = p_snapshot ->> 'objective',
        duration = p_snapshot ->> 'duration', status = (p_snapshot ->> 'status')::public.course_status,
        version = version + 1
      where id = p_entity_id and version = p_expected_version;
    when 'lesson' then
      update public.course_lessons set
        title = p_snapshot ->> 'title', summary = p_snapshot ->> 'summary',
        status = (p_snapshot ->> 'status')::public.course_status, version = version + 1
      where id = p_entity_id and version = p_expected_version;
    when 'assignment' then
      update public.course_assignments set
        title = p_snapshot ->> 'title', instructions_json = p_snapshot -> 'instructions',
        inputs_json = p_snapshot -> 'inputs', deliverables_json = p_snapshot -> 'deliverables',
        rubric_json = p_snapshot -> 'rubric', review_questions_json = p_snapshot -> 'reviewQuestions',
        instructor_note = p_snapshot ->> 'instructorNote',
        status = (p_snapshot ->> 'status')::public.course_status, version = version + 1
      where id = p_entity_id and version = p_expected_version;
    when 'appendix' then
      update public.course_appendices set
        title = p_snapshot ->> 'title', content_json = p_snapshot -> 'content',
        status = (p_snapshot ->> 'status')::public.course_status, version = version + 1
      where id = p_entity_id and version = p_expected_version;
    else
      raise exception 'unsupported editable course entity kind' using errcode = '22023';
  end case;
  if not found then raise exception 'stale course entity version' using errcode = '40001'; end if;
  return private_course_editor.course_entity_snapshot(p_kind, p_entity_id);
end
$function$

end
$function$
